_doc: THE WORKER ENVELOPE (V2-831 T-27). Background work shares the host with the voice, and a host that runs out of
memory freezes the voice first: measured on a 1 vCPU / 2 GB host, free memory fell 1275 MB -> 0 while two errands
ran, the VAD fell behind real time and the host froze. Every number here is a RATIO of what the host measures at
run time (psutil), never an absolute for one machine, so the same file holds on a laptop, a 2 GB Machine or a
bigger plan. A deployment that needs other values writes `config/resources.json` beside this file (same keys).
`admit_wait_s` bounds the wait for room by a clock; past it the worker starts anyway, at its lower priority.
`voice_lag_s` is the voice's own lag bound (T-30): over it, an event, one spoken notice and load shed.
THE SELF WATCHDOG (T-28): a thread beats the server loop; `freeze_s` without an answer, or free memory under
`pause_free_ratio`, sheds load; still so after `stuck_s` and under a supervisor (ZAELAR_SUPERVISED=1) it exits
non-zero for a restart, ended hard `exit_grace_s` later if the loop cannot shut down.
`summary_push_s` (T-31): how often the compact summary goes to ZAELAR_SUMMARY_URL, when a deployment sets one.
`browser_bg_wait_s` (pass 10): how long a background search waits for HIS turn's search in the one browser.
